original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 1 Product Name exactly identifies the approved server model/SKU family, is not a placeholder or different identity layer, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Collect full Type 1 on the asset-mapped SUT, compare Product Name with the project product/SKU recipe and corroborating Manufacturer/Version/Serial/UUID, run the approved reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the exact product identity and plan. Collection, reboot and field comparison are automatable.
safety_requirements: Preserve full Type 1 and errors before extracting Product Name.
Do not accept a baseboard name, chassis type, generic family or placeholder as the system product.
Stop on wrong asset/SKU mapping, identity drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw Type 1/tool/asset identity, compare exact Product Name and corroborating fields before/after reboot.
Do not modify DMI, infer SKU from one string or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve product/SKU identity, aliases and asset mapping.
Resolve branding/configuration discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode -t 1 is appropriate, but filtered-only output, stderr suppression and insecure SSH assumptions reduce reliability.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved transport; archive dmidecode --version and full sudo dmidecode -t 1 output, then extract Product Name before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 1 script, Product Name scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind Product Name to SKU/configuration and asset identity, retain surrounding Type 1 fields and reject placeholders/other identity layers across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved system product/SKU identity recipe and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds SKU/asset correlation and explicit alias/placeholder handling.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A marketing family name may be valid only for selected projects; configuration-specific identity rules must be explicit.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a customer-specific Product Name or alias. It must record the exact mapping and tested SKU.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected Product Name/aliases, SKU/asset identity and tool version
Raw pre-reboot Type 1 plus exact product comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion coherently define the Type 1 Product Name check.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field/method are clear; expected SKU/package/window are readiness inputs.
